[SWS_UdpNm_00506]
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_02572
⌈If
UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled
is
set
to
TRUE
and
UdpNm_ActivateTxPnShutdownMsg
is
called
with
a
valid
NM-Channel
(
nmChannelHandle), then the UdpNm module shall consider the PN shutdown
message transmission as active on the given NM-channel, set PNSR bit in the CBV to
1 and return with E_OK.⌋
